run_POP_training: run the main training loop for all agents in the POP game with command line params
run_POP_training_from_checkpoint: run POP training by adding agents to a population of trained agents from a checkpoint path
build_POP_game: build a POP game instance using get_common_opts and build_game from command line arguments
build_POP_second_game: build a second POP game by loading metadata from a wandb checkpoint and merging params
review_main_training_flow: review the main function that handles game building, dataloading, optimizer setup, and trainer execution
